Good to Know

Can I bring a plus-one?

Plus-ones are warmly welcome — please add their name on your RSVP so we can plan their seat and meal.

Are children invited?

Yes! Little ones are part of the celebration. A kids' menu is available — just note it in your RSVP.

What should I wear?

Garden formal. The ceremony and cocktails are outdoors on grass, so block heels, wedges or flats are your friends.

Is there parking?

Yes — complimentary parking is available at the venue, and a shuttle runs to the three hotels above at the end of the evening.

When should I RSVP by?

Please respond by … so we can finalise seating and catering. We can't wait to celebrate with you!

How we got here

Our Story

Chapter One

How We Met

A rainy Saturday, one umbrella, and a very muddy garden path. He offered the umbrella; she offered directions — and they have been walking the same way ever since.

Chapter Two

The Proposal

Two springs later, beneath the garden arch, he knelt with his grandmother's ring and one simple question. The answer was yes before he had finished asking.

Chapter Three

Forever Begins

Now we say our vows where it all began, surrounded by everyone we love most. Thank you for being part of our story — the best chapters are still to come.
